WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT id, created_at FROM users
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'
),
orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM order_items oi
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT c.id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS n_orders
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = c.id AND o.order_time < c.created_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
  GROUP BY c.id
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n_orders >= 2)::numeric / COUNT(*) AS share,
  COUNT(*) AS total_users
FROM qualified

WITH u AS (
  SELECT id, traffic_source FROM users
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
rev AS (
  SELECT u.traffic_source, u.id AS user_id, SUM(oi.sale_price) AS revenue
  FROM u
  LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
    AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY u.traffic_source, u.id
)
SELECT traffic_source,
       SUM(COALESCE(revenue,0)) AS total_revenue,
       COUNT(*) AS user_count,
       ROUND((SUM(COALESCE(revenue,0)) / COUNT(*))::numeric, 2) AS revenue_per_user
FROM rev
GROUP BY traffic_source
ORDER BY revenue_per_user DESC

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT id AS user_id, date_trunc('month', created_at) AS acq_month
  FROM users
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
rev AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, SUM(oi.sale_price) AS net_rev
  FROM order_items oi
  WHERE oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
    AND oi.status <> 'Returned'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id
)
SELECT c.acq_month, COUNT(*) AS users_created, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.net_rev),0)::numeric,2) AS total_net_revenue
FROM cohort c
LEFT JOIN rev r ON r.user_id = c.user_id
GROUP BY c.acq_month
ORDER BY c.acq_month

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT id FROM users
  WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
order_times AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN cohort c ON oi.user_id = c.id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM order_times
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT r1.user_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r2.order_time - r1.order_time))/86400.0 AS days_diff
  FROM ranked r1
  JOIN ranked r2 ON r1.user_id = r2.user_id AND r1.rn=1 AND r2.rn=2
)
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff) AS median_days
FROM pairs

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT id AS user_id, created_at, to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month
  FROM users
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
orders_flag AS (
  SELECT c.user_id, c.month,
    MAX(CASE WHEN oi.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_order
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN order_items oi
    ON oi.user_id = c.user_id
    AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at >= c.created_at
    AND oi.created_at < c.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
  GROUP BY c.user_id, c.month
)
SELECT month, COUNT(*) AS total_users, SUM(has_order) AS converted,
  ROUND(SUM(has_order)::numeric / COUNT(*), 4) AS share
FROM orders_flag
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY share DESC

WITH facebook_users AS (
  SELECT id FROM users
  WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
order_times AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN facebook_users fu ON oi.user_id = fu.id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM order_times
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT user_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN order_time END) AS t2,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn=3 THEN order_time END) AS t3
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN rn=3 THEN order_time END) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t3-t2))/86400.0) AS median_days
FROM pivoted

WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT user_id, SUM(sale_price) AS spend
  FROM order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
    AND status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY spend) AS p90
FROM per_user

WITH orders AS (
  SELECT oi.order_id, oi.user_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM order_items oi
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.order_id, oi.user_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT o.user_id, o.order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.order_time) AS rn
  FROM orders o
  JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id
  WHERE u.traffic_source = 'Organic'
    AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         MAX(order_time) FILTER (WHERE rn=1) AS first_order,
         MAX(order_time) FILTER (WHERE rn=2) AS second_order
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING MAX(order_time) FILTER (WHERE rn=2) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order-first_order))/86400.0) AS median_days
FROM pivot

WITH oi AS (
  SELECT order_id, user_id, created_at, sale_price
  FROM order_items
  WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, user_id, MIN(created_at) AS order_time, SUM(sale_price) AS order_value
  FROM oi
  GROUP BY order_id, user_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM orders
)
SELECT
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FILTER (WHERE rn=1) AS median_first,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FILTER (WHERE rn>1) AS median_repeat
FROM ranked

WITH orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_id, MIN(created_at) AS order_time
  FROM order_items
  WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY user_id, order_id
  HAVING MIN(created_at) >= '2024-01-01' AND MIN(created_at) < '2025-01-01'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM orders
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN order_time END) AS first_order,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order - first_order))/86400.0) AS p95_days
FROM pairs

WITH u AS (
  SELECT id FROM users WHERE traffic_source='Search' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
ord AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'

  SELECT user_id, order_time,

  FROM ord
),
pair AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN order_time END) AS first_o,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN order_time END) AS second_o
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_o - first_o))/86400.0) AS median_days
FROM pair
